verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Literature returns 'high-accuracy, cited' responses and Kosmos produces 'comprehensive cited' reports. They also say 'every conclusion is fully auditable,' letting you trace any finding back to 'the specific code or literature passage that produced it,' which covers per-claim verification against sources. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the citation format and granularity (e.g., inline per-claim citations, passage-level links in the output), and independent or hands-on corroboration that every substantive claim is actually cited.
